Delhi University Colleges Admit Students Based on 12th Marks

Several Delhi University colleges are admitting students for the 2026 academic session based on Class 12 marks, bypassing the CUET exam. This admission process is reportedly leading to vacant seats in these colleges. The shift to accepting Class 12 merit for admission is being implemented in specific DU colleges.
